title: cdk-construct-sns examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-sns/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — standard topic, no encryption
- standard-with-dlq/ — sqsDlqEnabled:true (divergent: adds SQS DLQ)
- fifo/ — fifoTopic:true, contentBasedDeduplication:true (divergent: FIFO resource type)
- encrypted/ — KMS encryption from bridge fixture
- with-subscribers/ — SQS and Lambda subscriber types

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/sns-examples.test.ts.
